label: Order Cancellation Rate
description: Percentage of orders that were cancelled.
formula_plain_english: percentage of orders where transaction_status is a cancelled value
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN {{transaction_status}} IN {{cancelled_values}} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancellation_percent, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM {{fact}}
